user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we want to listen to some great music along the way. Can you suggest some popular songs and playlists that we can add to our road trip playlist? Also, provide us with the album details of our favorite artist.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of popular songs suitable for road trips.
Compile popular playlists from music streaming platforms that fit a road trip theme.
Retrieve album details of the user's favorite artist.
Combine the results from tasks 1, 2, and 3 into a comprehensive road trip music playlist.
